commits.subject: fix(scheduler): use earliest pick game for result polling, not primary-only
commits.body:
Bug: scheduler.py:967 computed poll_start from `daily.pick.game_time + 10min`.
When the double-down's game starts before the primary's, scheduler slept
through the earlier game. run_result_polling already tracks both game_pks
internally (line 521-522), but never ran because the scheduler was
blocked in time.sleep until the primary's game start.

Observed live 2026-04-22: Laureano (SD, 20:40 ET) primary + Henderson
(BAL, 14:10 ET) double-down. Scheduler slept until 20:50, missing
Henderson's full live-game window. Dashboard fetch_live_scorecard runs
independently so display was unaffected, but daily.result was not
persisted mid-game. 1 AM check-results cron still backfills final
results, so pick-ledger correctness stays intact.

Fix: new _compute_result_poll_start(daily) wraps _earliest_pick_game_et
+ 10min (same helper used for the 2026-04-20 fallback-deadline fix).
Extracted from inline code to make it unit-testable.

3 new tests in TestComputeResultPollStart — primary-only, primary-earlier,
double-down-earlier (the Laureano+Henderson regression). Full suite 557
passed.
